Scope: self-audit of the T-66/T-67 session (recovery-integrity remediation, closure-evidence reverify sweep, two SHIP blocks) against the SAIPEN contracts, at source_head 77be0ec with the current dirty tree (T-66/T-67 work uncommitted). Evidence basis: LOG E-733..E-767, BOARD, suite records, gate re-runs.

IMP-001 [P2] [PROJECT_VIOLATION] [observed] [note]
expected: every byte of the reviewed scope is verified at the boundary that authorizes it; release-surface edits and scope attribution enter before the REVIEW DEC, or re-enter VERIFY/REVIEW afterwards (the archived cycle's IMP-001 class: release-surface edits inside SHIP after the review boundary)
expected-bounded: no release-surface or attribution write happens between the REVIEW DEC verdict and the ship gate
actual: CHANGELOG.md was edited and both scope records (scope-a35fb72e for T-66, scope-8b174dd8 for T-67) were written AFTER the transition into SHIP, i.e. after the REVIEW boundary, so parts of the shipped scope were never inside a verification boundary
actual-bounded: nothing was published (publication blocked), so no shipped release carried unverified bytes; ship.md step 1 itself prescribes release-material updates inside SHIP, which is what creates the ambiguity between the procedure and the historical violation class
evidence: LOG order: transition-7817ff17 REVIEW T-66, checkpoint-e3be5946 DEC SHIP, transition-88fb9057 SHIP, then Edit CHANGELOG.md and scope-a35fb72e/scope-8b174dd8; validate.py --gate ship ran after those edits and is green; git ls-remote origin 403 means no release exists

IMP-002 [P3] [PROJECT_VIOLATION] [observed] [note]
expected: one verification produces one evidence line, journaled inside the phase that owns it
expected-bounded: a checkpoint written in the wrong phase is retracted, not re-written alongside
actual: the first 'verify -> PASS [target: T-67]' RUN line was checkpointed while T-67 was still in BUILD (the engine refused the REVIEW transition with INCOMPLETE_TICKET), and the same verification was then checkpointed again inside VERIFY, leaving two evidence lines for one run
actual-bounded: the engine consumed only the VERIFY-phase line; the BUILD-phase line is inert duplication, not false evidence
evidence: checkpoint-ba10d313 (BUILD phase) followed by transition refusal INCOMPLETE_TICKET, then checkpoint-603a046e (VERIFY phase) accepted; both lines exist in .saipen/LOG.md

IMP-003 [P3] [OTHER] [observed] [note]
expected: when every workable ticket is blocked on an external condition, the session surfaces one operator-visible terminal state (WAIT with the blocker)
expected-bounded: the routing names the blocked tickets or stops at a wait, rather than opening new discovery work
actual: with T-66 and T-67 both blocked on the suspended origin, STATE.next_action is 'saipen continue' and the launcher admitted a fresh improve cycle; the operator-facing terminal state lives only inside the two tickets' blocker fields, and nothing in the routing states that publication is impossible
evidence: .saipen/STATE.md next_action 'saipen continue', blocker ''; continue --json returned IMPROVE_AUDIT_ASSIGNMENT for imp-vacterro-smart-vac-duplicate-remover-20261016-1; T-66 and T-67 both under ## BLOCKED with origin-suspension blockers
